name: ToastProvider
description: Provides toast state to its children and shows each toast added through `useToastManager` or a `toastManager`, with an icon, title, description, action, and close button. Doesn't render its own HTML element.

props.name: children
props.description: Part of the app that can show toasts, typically the whole app.

props.name: toastManager
props.description: Toast manager created with `createToastManager`, for adding toasts from outside React components.

props.name: limit
props.description:
The maximum number of toasts that can be displayed at once.
When the limit is exceeded, the oldest toasts are marked as `limited` (via the `data-limited`
attribute) rather than removed, so they can be hidden or animated out.

props.name: timeout
props.description:
The default amount of time (in ms) before a toast is auto dismissed.
A value of `0` will prevent the toast from being dismissed automatically.
